column1: # The declared four-quadrant delivery receipts of the corrected source-bearing
# protocol (VAL-SUB-010, Gate C offline half).
# One row per evidence operation the run actually performed. The four quadrants
# are separated and never conflated:
#   physicalBytes  the bytes physically read and digest-verified;
#   preparedBytes  the bytes prepared into a model-facing payload;
#   accepted       whether the native tool result completed and was accepted by
#                  the declared output schema (a schema/render failure or an
#                  interrupted return is NOT accepted);
#   visibleBytes   the bytes the ACCEPTED result actually delivered (zero for an
#                  unaccepted row, so a failure is never counted as delivery);
#   used           a later demonstrable request/action/checkpoint reference, or
#                  the literal Unavailable when unobservable.
# Row type (first field):
#   receipt <operation> <world> <revision> <identity> <physical> <prepared> <accepted|not-accepted> <visible> <used|Unavailable>
# The rows are the corrected protocol's own delivery sequence over the real
# retained capawesome-team_cli_126 world: a progressive page, the full-source
# escape, an overflow whole-file page and its memoized continuation, a render
# failure that is NOT delivery, and a later observable use. No gold, no task
# identity and no evaluator label is present.
